title: Repairs from final review of Persistence foundation
description:
Repairs routed from the epic's final review (tick me4). Apply exactly these; nothing else.
1. src/lib/db/index.ts: add `export type { DatabaseSync } from "node:sqlite";`. src/lib/tasks/repository.ts: replace `type DatabaseSync = TestDb["db"]` with `import type { DatabaseSync } from "@/lib/db";` (drop the TestDb import if now unused). scripts/check-rules.test.ts must still pass (the barrel is inside src/lib/db/).
2. src/lib/tasks/repository.integration.test.ts: make the done-ordering test discriminate `ORDER BY done_at DESC, id DESC` from `ORDER BY id DESC`: create tasks 1 and 2, mark task 2 done first, then task 1 done with a later timestamp (use `vi.useFakeTimers()` + `vi.setSystemTime()` and advance between the two setDone calls; restore real timers in afterEach), and expect done ids `[1, 2]`. Also make the updateTask test prove the bump: advance the fake clock between createTask and updateTask and assert `updatedAt > createdAt` strictly (string comparison of ISO timestamps is fine).
3. src/lib/db/migrate.ts: guard the rollback: `if (db.isTransaction) db.exec("ROLLBACK");` (node:sqlite on Node 26 exposes `isTransaction`). Change the rollback test in src/lib/db/open.integration.test.ts to use a migration whose sql is `"CREATE TABLE y(a); CREATE TABLE ("` and assert afterwards that table `y` does not exist and schema_migrations has no row for it. Remove the duplicate 201-character CHECK test from open.integration.test.ts (it lives in the repository test).
4. docs/current/testing.md: fix the "Writing a test" bullet to name real files: `src/lib/tasks/validate.test.ts` beside `src/lib/tasks/validate.ts`. docs/current/how/persistence.md: the "Public surface of the persistence layer" row of Key entry points also lists `Migration`, `TestDb` and `DatabaseSync`.
5. eslint.config.mjs: add "coverage/**" to the ignores so `pnpm lint` does not warn after `pnpm test:coverage`.
Run: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm docs:check
